voice.summary: Inkwell & Co. sounds like a foundry owner showing a friend a specimen sheet. It is knowledgeable, quietly opinionated and always more interested in the letters than in itself.
dos: Name the typeface, weight and size
Use specimen language: ascender, counter, tracking
Invite the reader to type and test
donts: Do not call fonts 'beautiful' without a reason
Do not use more than one adjective per feature

taglines: Click the text to edit it
Set it, test it, copy the CSS
boilerplate: Inkwell & Co. is an independent type foundry whose Type Lab lets designers test fonts, pairings and settings live and copy the resulting CSS.

microcopy.success: CSS copied. Paste it into your stylesheet.
microcopy.error: That weight is not available for this family.

logo.note: An ink drop is the classic mark of type and print.
